title: Boethius, the logical works, in Patrologiae cursus completus, series Latina 64, ed. J.-P. Migne (Paris, 1847)
edition: Migne PL 64 (Boethius II): the commentaries on Porphyry, the Categories, De interpretatione and Cicero's Topica; the Introductio ad syllogismos categoricos, De syllogismo categorico, De syllogismo hypothetico, De divisione, De differentiis topicis; the Archive's text layer

normalization: The Internet Archive's own text layer (_djvu.txt) as served, under original/<identifier>/, copied to text/<slug>.ocr.txt with line endings normalized. The scan is held by reference at its Archive URL and not copied. No text was corrected by hand; the loci keep the OCR's readings.
scope: The volume whole: the Latin Organon as the Middle Ages received it.
why_seated: The Latin gap of §11.6: the handbooks through which the syllogism reached the schools.
verified_loci: Introductio ad syllogismos categoricos — 'INTRODUCTIO AD SYLLOGISMOS CATEGORICOS' (text/pl64.ocr.txt)

research.study: Critique of Pure Inference (working draft v1.1) and The Production of Readers (#1767), §11.6 "the witnesses between"
research.for: the reception history of inference from the Peripatos to the machine: the commentators who name Aristotle's ἑταῖροι, the Latin handbooks, the early-modern refusals of the syllogism, the nineteenth-century rebuilds, and the traditions that reasoned about inference without the Organon
